components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid aurora gradient CTA for the primary conversion action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#2563eb); color:#fff; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:0.9375rem; letter-spacing:0.02em; padding:14px 32px; border:none; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(124,58,237,0.4); cursor:pointer; transition:filter 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.15); transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(124,58,237,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a855f7; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Translucent glass button with aurora border; gradient fill fades in on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:12px 28px; border-radius:8px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-weight:600; font-size:0.9375rem; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:#fff; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border:1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.25); box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(124,58,237,0.09),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px); overflow:hidden; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-glass::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#2563eb); opacity:0; transition:opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-glass:hover::before { opacity:1; } .ds-btn-glass span { position:relative; z-index:1; } .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a855f7; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Translucent service/feature card; lifts and brightens its glow on hover.

Full Stack Development

components.css: .ds-card-glass { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:14px; padding:24px; color:#fafafa; backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(180%); box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(124,58,237,0.09),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05); transition:transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card-glass:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(124,58,237,0.12),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-card-glass h3 { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:1.25rem; margin:0 0 8px; } .ds-card-glass p { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:400; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.6; color:#8e8e8e; margin:0; }

components.name: Glass Nav
components.description: Sticky glass navigation bar with gradient logo and aurora hover links.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; padding:12px 24px; border-radius:14px; background:rgba(8,8,16,0.7); border:1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.2); box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.3),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04); backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(200%); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(200%); } .ds-nav-logo { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#2563eb,#06b6d4); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; } .ds-nav a { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.9375rem; color:#fafafa; text-decoration:none; transition:color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#a855f7; }

components.name: Preheading Code Chip
components.description: Inline code-tag chip wrapping a mono label in angle brackets; rose-to-pink gradient-text (sanctioned background-clip:text use).
components.css: .ds-preheading { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:6px 16px; border-radius:9999px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.02em; background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgb(244,63,94),rgb(236,72,153)); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(244,63,94,0.3); border:1px solid rgba(244,63,94,0.3); } .ds-preheading::before { content:'<'; opacity:0.6; margin-right:4px; } .ds-preheading::after { content:'/>'; opacity:0.6; margin-left:4px; }

narrative.overview: A dark engineering surface, lit from within by an aurora. The system reads like a senior developer's workspace at night: near-black ground (#080810), monospace code motifs, and sweeping violet-to-cyan gradients that behave like atmospheric light rather than decoration. Code is the native language here, not a costume: npm-style commands, function-named CTAs, terminal panels, and angle-bracket chips carry real developer fluency. The aurora is a seasoning, not the meal. Saturated color arrives in mesh backgrounds, hover fills, and a single sweeping headline gradient, then yields to quiet dark space so the craft reads as precise rather than loud. The whole composition exists to prove competence: the site is the portfolio, so every edge, transition, and contrast ratio is the pitch.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first (OLED), violet-tinted near-black ground; no light mode, no theme toggle.
Aurora gradient (violet to blue to cyan) as primary identity, used sparingly.
Monospace code motifs as authentic developer signal.
Luminous glass surfaces with precise 8px edges and visible aurora focus rings.
Choreographed GSAP motion, fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Reserved Aurora Rule
rules.body: Full saturated gradient appears on roughly one element per viewport (a headline, a hero mesh, a primary CTA). Its rarity is what keeps it from reading as crypto-neon. If two gradients compete on one screen, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Tint-the-Dark Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are never pure #000/#fff. The ground is violet-tinted near-black; text is #fafafa, not white.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks something that is genuinely code or command-like (a CTA verb, a section signature, a terminal line). It is never used for running prose to look technical.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Drop Rule
rules.body: Elevation is conveyed by colored glow and tonal lift, not by heavy black drop-shadows. If a shadow looks gray and hard, it is wrong for this system.

rules.name: The Syntax-Accent Rule
rules.body: Rose, pink, and indigo appear only on code-syntax surfaces (preheading chips, code-styled heading tokens). They never leak onto UI chrome, buttons, or body text, where the aurora set owns color.

dos: Do keep the ground violet-tinted near-black (#080810); float everything on it.
Do spend the full aurora gradient on roughly one element per viewport (Reserved Aurora Rule), then let dark space breathe.
Do use monospace only for genuinely code-like content (CTAs, signatures, terminals).
Do convey depth with colored glow and tonal layering, not hard black drop-shadows.
Do show a 2px aurora focus ring on every interactive element, and honor prefers-reduced-motion (the stylesheet already collapses animation to ~0ms).
Do audit gradient and glass text for WCAG 2.2 AA contrast against the dark ground.
donts: Don't ship generic template-agency layouts: stock-photo heroes, lorem filler, or endless identical icon-heading-text card grids.
Don't tip the aurora palette into crypto/neon hype: no glow overload, no neon-on-black swagger, no web3 buzzword energy.
Don't read as stiff corporate sterility (navy-suit, IBM/Accenture) or as a cluttered, ad-heavy marketplace.
Don't use background-clip: text gradients as decoration outside the one sanctioned headline sweep, and never a colored border-left/border-right stripe as an accent.
Don't use pure #000 or #fff, and don't introduce a light mode or theme toggle.
Don't let glass blur and glow become a default texture on every element; it is purposeful, or it is absent.
